name: Varbase Social Single Sign-On
description: Social login for Varbase via the Social API — Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Google and others.
project_description:
Adds single sign-on using existing information from a social networking service. Such as Facebook , LinkedIn , or Google . Built using Social API .

 

 
 

 
 
 Requirements: 
 
 Social API. 
 Social Auth. 
 Social Auth Google. 
 Social Auth Facebook. 
 Social Auth Linkedin. 
 
 

 
 

 Back to top 

 Use With Varbase Distribution: 
 This module is best used with Varbase distribution.

 Can be installed with any Drupal site. Even if installed with the Minimal or Standard profile.

 However, using it with Varbase gives you way much more cool stuff!
